item: The cause of the red two-process dismissal-reason test is the store's 1000-entry cap
status: not a lost update (fix in PR 1469)
column9: The test failed once on CI (PR 1466): the parent recorded reasons for as long as the child lived, the child took seconds to start on that runner, the parent wrote 1547 reasons, and the store (cap 1000) correctly dropped the oldest 587. Not a lost update: reproduced locally with a child that sleeps 6 s before writing (2493 written, missing = the contiguous prefix parent-0..parent-1532, every child reason present), which is exactly the cap. The fix itself landed first in PR 1469 (the same ready-file shape, found independently by three lanes: the parent starts when the child announces it is writing and stops short of the cap), so this PR carries only the analysis: the other six loop-until-the-child-exits tests (diagnostics runs, session history, activity ledger, annotations, errorlog trim, pass journal) and the draft and dismissed stores were checked and have no cap the parent can reach.
